title: ChatUI Backup Envelope Header
description: The UTF-8 canonical JSON header of a ChatUI backup envelope. This schema models the header JSON, not the binary envelope. Byte layout (M5-decisions.md DEC-M5-05): offset 0, 8 bytes ASCII magic "CHATUI1\n" (43 48 41 54 55 49 31 0a); offset 8, 4 bytes big-endian uint32 headerLength; offset 12, headerLength bytes UTF-8 canonical JSON header; offset 12 + headerLength, 12 random IV bytes; offset 24 + headerLength, n bytes AES-256-GCM ciphertext; offset 24 + headerLength + n, 16 bytes AES-256-GCM tag. The envelope remainder after the IV is ciphertext || tag. headerLength must be greater than 0 and at most 65536 bytes. Canonical serialization is UTF-8 JSON with no insignificant whitespace and keys in the order v, formatVersion, alg, kdf, iterations, salt, objectType, objectKey.

v.description: Envelope format version. v1 clients reject any other value with unsupported-version before decrypting.

formatVersion.description: Backup payload format version. v1 clients reject any other value with unsupported-version before decrypting.

alg.description: AEAD algorithm. v1 clients reject any other value with unsupported-alg.

kdf.description: Key-derivation function wire value. v1 uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256. v1 clients reject any other value with unsupported-kdf.

salt.description: Standard base64 with padding of the 16-byte backup-set salt. The salt is repeated in every envelope header and must match the manifest salt.

objectType.description: Backup object type. Other manifest schema values are reserved and are not valid in a v1 backup envelope.

objectKey.description: ASCII storage path bound by the AAD. Must match the object's actual storage path.
